name: Zalo Ultra Chromium Flags Specification
description: Optimized Chromium command-line switches for Zalo PC Electron runtime: minimal RAM/CPU, zero telemetry, preserved native features.

memory_and_gc.purpose: Exposes V8 Garbage Collection to JavaScript (global.gc() and window.gc())
memory_and_gc.impact: Enables proactive memory recovery; reduces working set by 30-50% on idle or minimize

memory_and_gc.purpose: Caps maximum renderer process pool for utility and background tasks
memory_and_gc.impact: Prevents runaway child process spawning; saves 80-150MB RSS

cache_and_io.impact: Prevents Cache and DawnCache folders from ballooning into hundreds of megabytes on SSD

cache_and_io.purpose: Restricts media stream disk cache to 32MB
cache_and_io.impact: Prevents video/audio cache accumulation; reduces disk write wear

telemetry_and_crash_suppression.purpose: Disables Chromium native breakpad crash handler
telemetry_and_crash_suppression.impact: Prevents creation of crashpad_handler.exe processes and minidump disk writes

telemetry_and_crash_suppression.purpose: Disables Chromium background component updates (e.g. CRLSets)
telemetry_and_crash_suppression.impact: Eliminates unwanted background network pings and disk updates

telemetry_and_crash_suppression.purpose: Disables Google Domain Reliability network telemetry reporting
telemetry_and_crash_suppression.impact: Prevents network error reporting upstream; saves background sockets
Saves idle CPU cycles and background bandwidth

telemetry_and_crash_suppression.purpose: Disables Web Speech API recognition service
telemetry_and_crash_suppression.impact: Reduces Chromium internal audio pipeline overhead

telemetry_and_crash_suppression.purpose: Sets Chromium log level to fatal errors only
telemetry_and_crash_suppression.impact: Prevents Chromium diagnostic messages from degrading performance

native_feature_preservation.purpose: Bypasses standard 6-connection per host limit for Zalo file CDN
native_feature_preservation.impact: MANDATORY: Ensures high-speed concurrent photo, video and document transfers in Zalo
Preserves Zalo desktop UI layout integrity

native_feature_preservation.purpose: Enables WebAssembly and JPEG XL image format decoding
native_feature_preservation.impact: MANDATORY: Zalo uses JXL for optimized stickers/photos and WASM for Signal E2EE encryption
